task.title: Implement parallel scheduler and publisher queue
task.summary: Add safe parallel roadmap execution through sprint/task partitioning, artifact claims, role worktrees or refs, fresh validation, and serialized publisher queue proof.

goal.outcome: CodeWiki can safely allocate non-conflicting sprint/task workers and serialize final merge/closure through publisher proof.
acceptance: Scheduler computes non-conflicting sprint/task partitions from declared write scopes and artifact-status availability.
Builder, validator, and publisher roles record worktree/branch/ref metadata and claims with TTL/heartbeat/release semantics.
Fresh validation consumes immutable refs from worker outputs and does not reuse builder chat context.
Publisher queue serializes merge/apply, generated-state refresh, final commit/tree proof, and task-close/publication readiness.
Tests cover non-conflicting parallel allocation, write/write conflict blocking, wait/wake readiness, validation isolation, and publisher serialization.
non_goals: Do not implement generic cloud/remote worker infrastructure.
Do not bypass Git/content proof or validation isolation.
Do not allow shared-root parallel writes when role worktrees/refs are required.
verification: claim wait queue and role worktree isolation tests

commit.title: feat(codewiki): plan parallel scheduler publishing
commit.body:
Implement TASK-044 scheduler and publisher queue proof.

- compute non-conflicting task partitions from declared write scopes
- block allocations on artifact claims, partition conflicts, and session limits
- emit builder/validator role worktree plans with claim heartbeat/release metadata
- define serialized publisher queue proof with clean commit/tree requirements
- surface scheduler output in agency work-mode planning
- extend smoke tests for scheduler, wait/wake, isolation, and publisher serialization

Checks: npm run typecheck; npm run test:smoke; npm run test:features; npm run test:pack; npm run check:architecture
